identity.title: Verify deployed SDK provenance against loaded DLLs

origin.summary: The 2D plan requires proving that a runtime copied outside the checkout reports the SDK actually loaded, rather than silently falling back to a repository-only manifest or presenting a mismatched DLL set as normal identity.

state.current_summary: 2D-046 is resolved in the existing VisionPipelineExecutionPlan -> VisionRecipeRunner provenance path. A deployment-root sdk-manifest.json sidecar is now copied and checked against the loaded SDK assembly and every declared SDK file by length and SHA-256, with an embedded manifest-hash anchor and clean-runtime manifest cross-check. BOM-safe parsing was corrected after the canonical Release manifest exposed the issue. Debug and Release builds, clean-runtime packaging, ReleaseDistributionCheck, checkout-free match/missing/mismatch fixtures, and the existing Debug pipeline-provenance regression pass. A broad Release PL-0008 runner attempt still stops at its pre-existing sample-validation path and is recorded as an unverified neighboring boundary, not as 2D-046 evidence. Another-PC/offline/installer/signing/update-rollback/privileged-writer/hardware qualification remains out of scope.

objective.summary: Prove that Debug and Release runtimes copied outside the source checkout identify the SDK files actually loaded, or explicitly report unavailable/mismatch when the sidecar or bytes cannot establish that identity.
constraints: Reuse VisionPipelineExecutionPlan.ResolveVisionSdkIdentity and the existing BuildCleanRuntime/TestReleaseDistribution packaging owners; do not add a parallel provenance service or generic plugin registry.
Use the authoritative dll/OpenVisionLab-Vision-SDK/sdk-manifest.json file entries and only observed file bytes; do not infer SDK internals from assembly names or versions.
Keep normal application identity and VisionPipelineExecutionProvenance fields compatible; a missing or mismatched deployment sidecar must never be presented as an exact SDK identity.
Use checkout-free deployment folders and all generated test evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Keep existing SDK DLL set, runtime files, and release archive behavior unchanged except for the sidecar/verification contract required by this issue.
Do not modify, stage, commit, or push C:\Git\2D\Original or any shared package repository.
Do not claim another-PC, offline, installer, signing, update/rollback, privileged-writer, or hardware qualification from local copied-folder evidence.

criteria.text: The existing provenance and packaging owners, call path, authoritative manifest schema, and checkout-free baseline are recorded; the baseline shows whether a copied runtime has a usable SDK identity and preserves any prior silent-fallback or unavailable behavior.

A deployment-side manifest/sidecar, when present and valid, is matched against the actual loaded SDK file path(s) by length and SHA-256; an exact match reports the SDK/source identity, while missing, malformed, wrong, or length/hash-mismatched files report explicit unavailable/mismatch and never normal exact identity.

Deterministic Debug and Release copied-folder contracts cover a valid match, manifest missing, different SDK metadata/path, and length/hash mismatch; focused builds and an existing pipeline provenance regression pass without changing the explicit run/result contract.

The issue, reconciliation report, stable feature contract, live handoff, and documentation map record the single owner/call path, sidecar policy, fixture cases, evidence, self-evaluation, and remaining deployment/offline/hardware boundaries so 2D-046 is not duplicated.

milestones.summary: Confirm the existing ResolveVisionSdkIdentity, BuildCleanRuntime, release verification, and sdk-manifest owners and preserve the PL-003/PL-005 dependency boundary.
Run and preserve a checkout-free deployment baseline plus explicit valid/missing/mismatch fixture cases before production edits.
Apply the smallest sidecar copy and loaded SDK file length/hash verification change, keeping the existing provenance owner and public fields compatible.
Run focused Debug/Release deployment contracts and record durable evidence, self-evaluation, and unverified boundaries in all required project documents.

context.summary: The existing execution-plan owner creates immutable pipeline provenance and currently discovers only a repository-relative sdk-manifest.json before reading its SDK version/commit and manifest hash.

BuildCleanRuntime records runtime file length/SHA and SDK metadata but currently does not copy the authoritative SDK manifest into the deployment root; TestReleaseDistribution validates the package manifest independently.
The SDK DLL/reference and external-binary inventory owners are already closed; this issue verifies deployment provenance without changing DLL contents or re-opening those owners.

context.location: VisionPipelineExecutionPlan.ResolveVisionSdkIdentity -> OpenVisionLab.csproj SDK references/content -> BuildCleanRuntime required files/manifest -> sdk-manifest.json -> TestReleaseDistribution -> copied-folder smoke
context.summary: This is the shortest code-reading and verification route for the deployment identity boundary.

evidence.observation: ResolveVisionSdkIdentity loads only a repository-relative dll/OpenVisionLab-Vision-SDK/sdk-manifest.json found by walking upward from AppContext.BaseDirectory, returns Manifest=unavailable when no copy is found, hashes the manifest JSON, and does not compare loaded SDK file bytes with the manifest files. BuildCleanRuntime records a separate clean_runtime_manifest.json but does not copy sdk-manifest.json into the payload.

The authoritative SDK manifest declares SDK version 3.0.0, source commit f4f0c0dc8bee5b7a849ae6eb66a5307bed4b8a6b, and length/SHA-256 entries for OpenVisionLab.Core.dll, OpenVisionLab.Vision2D.dll, OpenVisionLab.Vision2D.Blob.dll, OpenCvSharp.dll, and OpenCvSharp.Blob.dll. The application references these vendored files by repository-relative HintPath and copies the managed runtime DLLs into output.

A VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke copy executed from a checkout-free D: deployment folder with exit code 0 and the existing pipeline provenance contract passed, but the copied folder contained no sdk-manifest.json sidecar; the current production path therefore had no direct evidence of the exact SDK/source files and relied on the explicit unavailable branch. This baseline is preserved before the 2D-046 change.

The existing ResolveVisionSdkIdentity owner now prefers an adjacent deployment sidecar, falls back to the repository manifest only when no deployment copy exists, and returns explicit unavailable/mismatch states. TryValidateVisionSdkManifest enforces contained declared paths, length/SHA-256 for every SDK file, the loaded Vision2D assembly entry, and the embedded manifest hash anchor. The project copies sdk-manifest.json to build/publish output, BuildCleanRuntime requires and records its hash, TestReleaseDistribution verifies the package anchor, and JSON parsing accepts UTF-8 BOM payloads without changing the hashed bytes or public provenance fields.

The Dev clean runtime build completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors and emitted sdk-manifest.json plus clean_runtime_manifest.json. The Release clean runtime and win-x64 framework-dependent archive were rebuilt after the BOM fix. TestReleaseDistribution.ps1 -SkipLaunch completed with ReleaseDistributionCheck=PASS, a 76-file payload, SDK provenance 3.0.0 at commit f4f0c0dc8bee5b7a849ae6eb66a5307bed4b8a6b, and archive SHA-256 7915E913F99BFC1F93EDD308E1E2F67FC67F73EA0BF8B9A7C417F401FE672D7E. VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug/Release builds had 0 errors and the existing 19 nullable warnings.

A Debug VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke copy executed outside the checkout with the Dev clean-runtime manifest containing a UTF-8 BOM. The valid sidecar/package case passed with ManifestStatus=match and the expected SDK version/commit; the sidecar-free case passed with Manifest=unavailable and no exact manifest identity. The existing Debug PL-0008 pipeline-provenance regression also passed.

A Release VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke copy executed outside the checkout against the canonical 76-file Release clean-runtime manifest. The full BOM-bearing manifest passed with ManifestStatus=match, loaded OpenVisionLab.Vision2D.dll length 355328 and SHA-256 91A6D4DB01AA2E97F54BB5FF7A61FB0D0404432D0D86821E889350CCA5007B62, and the sidecar-free copy passed the explicit unavailable branch.

Release checkout-free mutation fixtures all passed their expected mismatch case: SDK metadata/commit mutation, sidecar length mutation, a byte mutation in OpenVisionLab.Core.dll, and a clean_runtime_manifest VisionSdkManifestSha256 mutation each produced ManifestStatus=mismatch and never the exact match status.

Self-evaluation preserved a canonical Release copied-folder failure before the parser correction: the production validator rejected the PowerShell-generated BOM-bearing clean_runtime_manifest.json even though the sidecar and all declared SDK bytes matched. After the minimal BOM-safe JSON parse change, the same full manifest and loaded DLL set passed from the checkout-free copied folder.

The durable issue, reconciliation report, live handoff, stable feature contract, and documentation map record 2D-046 as one existing-owner slice, link the sidecar/loaded-byte call path and D-drive cases, preserve the BOM self-correction and neighboring Release PL-0008 sample-validation limitation, and remove 2D-046 from the next-admission list without reopening completed owners.

events.summary: Admit one deployment-only provenance slice around the existing execution-plan and clean-runtime owners. First preserve the checkout-free unavailable baseline; then prefer copying the authoritative sdk-manifest.json sidecar and verifying loaded vendored SDK file bytes over adding a new manifest format or inferring DLL internals.
2D-046 acceptance and durable evidence are complete in the existing provenance and packaging owners.
